title: Compliance sketchpad — SOC2 prep notes (Mira)
content:
Purpose: quick, messy capture of open SOC2 evidence gaps and mapping ideas. Not a finished checklist — more of a scratch brain-dump to share with Jordan/ellie before the working sesh on 2026-03-06.

Top-level context notes (quick):
- Scope: hosted API + Dedicated pools + Private (VPC) deployments. Some controls differ by deployment mode (esp. data flow/evidence).
- Goal for this sprint: identify minimal evidence artifacts we can reliably produce in 2 sprints for the upcoming readiness review. Prioritize controls that auditors typically probe early: access management, logging & monitoring, change control, backups, incident response.

Immediate questions to clarify (to ask SRE/product owners):
1) Who is the canonical owner for Dedicated capacity provisioning and inventory? (Jira: JIRA-SEC-452 but need person)
2) For Private deployments we claim "customer-managed network" — do customers get separate KMS keys or do we offer a customer-managed key option? Need exact answer for encryption-at-rest control mapping.
3) Does the hosted API store any incoming prompts beyond short-term inference caches? (I think ephemeral only, except for logs/analytics) Need retention config and sample retention policy.
4) Are model artifacts considered "sensitive" in our asset register (weights, finetune checkpoints) or treated as product IP? This affects change control and access logs we must present.

Evidence mapping drafts (very rough):
- Logical access / IAM:
  - Policies: corporate IAM policy doc (CONFLUENCE-SEC-2201) + RBAC screenshots from Okta/GSuite admin + example user provisioning ticket (JIRA-OPS-1342).
  - Evidence to capture: export of Okta group memberships (csv), IAM role list, one example onboarding request + approval thread.
- MFA:
  - Evidence: conditional access policy screenshot + user MFA enforcement logs (last 90 days). Ask IAM team to snapshot.
- Logging & monitoring (important):
  - What we have: per-request tracing (token-level traces in console), aggregated Prometheus + Loki logs for infra, CloudBucket logs for S3.
  - Evidence to prepare: retention policy doc, sample alert runbook, demo query showing ingestion of an auth-failure event.
  - Gap: need a compiled export of platform access logs with timestamps linked to principal for last 6 months (ask SRE).
- Change control / release management:
  - What we can show: release calendar in GH + PR -> CI -> deploy pipeline (release-engineering owns).
  - Evidence: PR with approvals + release ticket + deployment audit from CI (timestamp + user).
  - Gap: older backfilled releases may not have complete approval traces; propose we retain forward only and provide compensating evidence for prior releases.
- Backups & recovery:
  - Evidence: backup schedule doc, restore drill notes (last drill?), S3 versioning + retention config.
  - Gap: do we have a documented RTO/RPO for model weights + metadata? If not, write a short RTO document.
- Vendor management / subproc controls:
  - Evidence: vendor inventory (who supports our model store, KMS, etc). We need signed contracts + vendor security questionnaires for top 5 vendors.

Draft control questions I expect auditors to ask (brainstorm):
- "How do you ensure customer data used during inference is segregated for Dedicated vs Hosted?"
- "Where do logs that contain request metadata live, and who has access?"
- "For customer-managed keys, show how key rotation/ownership is documented."
- "Demonstrate change approval for a model update that impacts production performance."
- "Show a recent security incident and the post-mortem / remediation timeline."

Evidence prioritization (MVP for readiness review):
1) Access exports (Okta + admin console) + 1 onboarding ticket (high value, low effort)
2) Logging retention policy + sample alert + 1 saved query showing auth failure
3) 1 release PR -> deployment trace with approvals + CI audit
4) Backup schedule + restore runbook (draft acceptable)
5) Clear statement about data retention for hosted inference (where prompts/logs go)

Notes about Private deployments (special cases):
- Customers often insist on local logging or allowlist network configs — auditors will ask how we verify we don’t have backdoor access. Need template docs for: deployment runbook, KMS key ownership statement, customer acceptance checklist.
- Also: for on-prem packages, we must show SHA256 checksums for installer artifacts and a signed release process. Add to evidence list.

Quick technical snippets / reminders to collect from infra teams:
- Export command for Okta group membership (example command or API call)
- Loki query that pulls auth failures: {job="auth"} |~ "401" | last()
- CI audit query: GH Actions > workflow run > show actor + commit SHA + deployment environment
- S3 policy JSON snippet for model store we can paste into evidence zip

To-do for next 7 days (owners in parens):
- Ask SRE to export last 6 months of platform access logs and anonymize PII (Jordan)
- Get Okta membership export and a short doc describing onboarding process (Ellie)
- Draft RTO/RPO statement for model artifacts and metadata (Mira)
- Compile vendor inventory from procurement and attach last security questionnaire (Mira + Legal)
- Prepare a canned evidence packet (zip) with named files and README for auditors (format: README.md, okta.csv, logs-sample.json, release-trace.pdf, backup-schedule.pdf) (Jordan + Mira)

Open decisions / unresolved:
- Retention windows: product team says analytics logs retained 12 months; security wants 24 months for investigations. Need compromise and documented justification.
- Model artifact classification: product wants to treat weights as IP; security wants more strict access logs. Need to align.
- Demo script: we should script a 15-min demo that shows key artifacts and a quick trace from event -> alert -> incident ticket. Who volunteers to run? (Jordan?)

Notes-to-self (formatting for the evidence zip):
- Put a one-page "how to read this packet" at root for auditors. Keep it plain.
- Each artifact should have a provenance line: who exported it, date/time, and any filters applied.
- Label any redacted fields clearly with reason.

Random ideas (experimental):
- Consider building a small "evidence collector" script that pulls exports and zips them with a manifest. Might be reusable across audits and helpful for customers requesting pen-test artifacts. Low MVP: Python script that calls Okta API, exports groups; fetches small subset of logs; snapshots CI run metadata. (Task for infra intern?)
- For Private deployments, create a short customer attestation template they can sign to confirm network isolation and KMS choice. Could speed audits for those customers.

End of brain-dump. Will clean up into a proper checklist after the 03/06 working session.

Mira
